lead.headline: Jackson Area credit union (Mississippi) holds $148.2M in deposits on $71.4M in assets: a $77M hole
lead.number: Deposits are 2.08x assets, the only one of 4,250 credit unions over 2x (median 0.86x); a $91.7M loss in Q1 2026 leaves net worth about -$77M (-107.9%)
lead.watch_out: Only one quarter (Q1 2026) is loaded, and the account codes behind the $91.7M loss are labeled by matching the data, not NCUA's dictionary.

First, NCUA filed a restated call report — the regulator’s own numbers, produced after it stepped in as conservator, insurer, and board. The restatement recognized a $91.7 million loss, cut cash by $93.6 million, and swung the net-worth ratio from positive 9% to negative 107%. That is not a number an institution survives; it is materially insolvent by a wide margin. Second, on June 11th, NCUA filed a federal lawsuit (hat tip to Frank Diekmann at CUToday for surfacing it). The revised financials show total assets plunged 62.5% in the first six months of 2026, falling from $162.4 million at year-end 2025 to $60.9 million, driven largely by a collapse in cash and deposits from $111.8 million to just $9 million. The credit union also posted a year-to-date net loss of $103 million, compared with $1.23 million in net income for all of 2025, while borrowings climbed from zero at year-end to nearly $13 million, underscoring the magnitude of the balance-sheet restructuring under NCUA conservatorship. sources.page_context: ervices Uninterrupted Alexandria, VA (May 6, 2026) ― The National Credit Union Administration (NCUA) today placed Jackson Area Federal Credit Union in Jackson, Mississippi into conservatorship. Member services will continue while NCUA works to resolve issues affecting the credit union’s operations. NCUA placed Jackson Area Federal Credit Union into conservatorship because of unsafe and unsound practices at the credit union. Member deposits at Jackson Area Federal Credit Union remain protected by the National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund (Share Insurance Fund), which has the backing of the full faith and credit of the United States.
